notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station and adding {G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
